external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app and may be an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.
external_entities.notes: The text does not distinguish separate entity types for admins and viewers.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payer's trust zone is not stated.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support-office worker who uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: The support agent's own account and one-time code are credentials.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which loads and saves invoices, enqueues PDF render jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Invoice ownership checks and request-time role checks are not recorded. The app uses one database account for all companies.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by each job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console's implementation, interface type, and placement are not recorded.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: The database has no row-level security. Its protection at rest and network placement are not recorded.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The queue's technology, placement, and protection are not recorded.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket holding rendered PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The bucket's protection at rest and network placement are not recorded. The billing app fetches PDFs using one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: Customer authentication uses an email address, password, and session cookie; there is no second factor.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer data, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: It is not recorded whether the app checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by invoice number

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits the whole invoice form to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The app saves every received field, including the paid flag and payout bank account. Role enforcement at request time is not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows the invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.notes: No payer authentication is required.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app to generate a PDF for an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether the request is authenticated beyond the user's billing-app session.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by invoice number

data_flows.name: load and query invoice
data_flows.description: The billing app reads invoice and related tenant data from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The database connection method and authentication are not recorded.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and company IDs

data_flows.name: save invoice
data_flows.description: The billing app writes received invoice fields to the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app saves every field it receives, including the paid flag and the company's payout bank account
data_flows.notes: The database connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoice fields, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and invoice number. The queue connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.notes: The queue connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer's database connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified using the job's company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The bucket connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The bucket connection method is not otherwise recorded.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: A support agent uses the admin console to open a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Actions are recorded against the customer user rather than the support agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and billing-app actions

data_flows.name: record user actions
data_flows.description: The billing app records actions performed in an opened customer-user session in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.notes: The database connection method is not recorded.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Records of actions attributed to the customer user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary containing people at that customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform zone containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app presents a web interface because customer users use it in a browser.
assumptions.basis: The description says people use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF renderer is a non-web process because it is a worker that consumes queue jobs and renders PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The description says the renderer takes jobs from a queue, reads an invoice, and writes a PDF.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include customer information and payout bank details, whose disclosure can harm people or the business.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered invoice PDFs derived from invoices and bank details.
assumptions.basis: The bucket stores PDFs generated from invoices, which the description says include financial and customer-related information.
